label: Updated 8 AM ET
title: Today In Golf
summary: A 30-second briefing on today’s biggest golf stories.

items.headline: DeChambeau, Rahm Leverage PGA Tour Absences
items.text: Bryson DeChambeau and Jon Rahm gain leverage as key stars like Scottie Scheffler and Rory McIlroy are absent from this week's Charles Schwab Challenge, while DeChambeau considers focusing on YouTube and majors amid PGA Tour return talks.

items.headline: Soo Bin Joo Leads ShopRite LPGA
items.text: Soo Bin Joo shot 3-under 68 in windy conditions and leads the ShopRite LPGA at 8-under 134 after two rounds, with only one bogey and 25 putts total.

items.headline: Niemann, Gooch Lead LIV Golf Korea
items.text: Joaquin Niemann and Talor Gooch share the 54-hole lead at LIV Golf Korea at 9-under, with Scott Vincent one back and Bryson DeChambeau and Dustin Johnson close behind.
